items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: I had to take shots by Dr. Shiffs who travels with the band now

ctx.x: So I want to see Glaser and I'm in the office with Joe Glaser and Joe Glaser says to me, " I don't know, Chief, you play with the big society orchestras, I don't know if I can afford you. Do you want to play with Louie?" I says, " I always want to play with

Louie. Who don't? A great opportunity. He said, "Well, what would you want for one-nighters?" I told him the price and Joe Glaser looked mad at me, "You'll never get it. Now, Chief, what would you want for location jobs?" I told him the price. He said, "You'll never get it." "Now what kind of price would you want to make records?" I told him and he said you'll never get it. But between what I wanted and what he was going to pay, we got down to the least or the most common denominator according to the way you look…
